name: FUN_WF_STAGES
description: This table contains approval stage data. Approval stage can be like invoice document approval stage and invoice line level approval stage.

columns.name: UPLOAD_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference identifier to the FUN_WF_RULE_UPLOADS table.

columns.name: PARENT_STAGE_ID
columns.description: Parent stage identifier to represent the stage in a sequential order.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier that the stages are at the same level and in parallel to each other.

columns.name: PARENT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Parent stage group identifier to represent the stage group in sequential order.

columns.name: STAGE_KEY
columns.description: Stage key in the resource bundle.

columns.name: STAGE_NAME
columns.description: Stage name on the BPM worklist application.

columns.name: REPETITIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if approval stage needs to be repeated in evaluation of approval rules.

columns.name: COLLECTION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the collection to be iterated in case of repetitive stage.

columns.name: DEFAULT_DIMENSION_FUNCTION
columns.description: Function to be used to populate the dimension id in the V2 list builder after unified decision service uptake.

columns.name: IGNORE_STAGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the stage is ignored.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
